verdict.rationale: The product documents its own hook for running saved tasks outside the in-app Start button: Siri, Shortcuts, widgets and Control Center can launch them, and runs continue in the background. That gives real non-interactive trigger entry points, but no first-party scheduler or external-event trigger is documented. Any time- or event-based automation would depend on the host Shortcuts platform, which earns no credit here. The Clock example is a task the agent performs, not scheduling of agent tasks. missing for 10: documented built-in scheduling, documented external-event or webhook/API triggers, explicit docs on triggering via Shortcuts automations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
